text:
Zoe: opened PR with a compact Private install preflight + troubleshooting doc. Focus: networking checks, KMS/HSM quick tests, and SDK transport failover examples. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1599

Raj: Nice. Can you list the exact preflight commands? I want to surface the minimal set for support to ask customers to run before we escalate.

Zoe: added a short checklist: 1) curl egress test (curl -sS https://ifconfig.co), 2) port check for 443/8443 via nc -vz, 3) PKCS#11 presence: ls -l $REDWOOD_PKCS11_PATH or which softhsm2-util, 4) time sync quick: timedatectl status.

Omar: For HSM, include a safe non-destructive test (pkcs11-tool --list-objects) with a note about vendor tools and permissions. Also mention SELinux file context as a frequent footgun.

Zoe: included the pkcs11-tool line and a SELinux chcon/restorecon snippet. Also added an example systemd socket unit for the local agent and a Node + Python SDK fallback pattern: try unix socket, then HTTP 127.0.0.1:8080.

Ingrid: docs lint flagged an internal anchor mismatch in networking.md. Also please avoid hardcoding sample vendor paths without showing alternatives. Add /opt/, /usr/lib64, and an env var example.

Zoe: switched to a short table of vendor paths and introduced REDWOOD_PKCS11_PATH with examples. Fixed the anchor.

DocOps Bot: docs-ci/build #655 started (staging: https://staging.docs.redwood-inference.internal/priv-preflight-1599)

Raj: One UX nit: the install flag --relax-route-checks should be documented to clarify it only bypasses route validation, not network mode. Customers keep thinking it toggles CNI.

Zoe: clarified and added link to installer flags table. Will push the tiny fixes; can someone watch the staging link and approve if CI is green?

Omar: I'll check the HSM snippets and the SELinux wording once you push. If green, :shipit:.
